description: This Java class implements the CollectionSheetReadPlatformService interface for Fineract. It provides methods to generate collection sheet data for groups, centers, and individuals, including handling nested data structures for loans and savings. The class uses JDBC templates to query the database, constructs complex SQL queries for retrieving collection sheet data, and processes result sets into domain-specific data objects. It also manages merging savings data into loan data and handles hierarchy and date validation logic.

classes.name: CollectionSheetReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of collection sheet data retrieval, including group, center, and individual collection sheets, handling complex SQL queries, data merging, and result mapping.

classes.name: JLGCollectionSheetFaltDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set rows into JLGCollectionSheetFlatData objects; constructs SQL schema for collection sheet queries.

classes.name: MandatorySavingsCollectionsheetExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor for extracting mandatory savings data and integrating it with collection sheet data.

classes.name: GroupSavingsDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping savings data into JLGGroupData objects, grouping clients under groups.

classes.name: ClientSavingsDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping savings data into JLGClientData objects, including nested savings details.

classes.name: SavingsDueDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping individual savings record rows into SavingsDueData objects.

classes.name: IndividualCollectionSheetFaltDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping individual collection sheet data rows into IndividualCollectionSheetLoanFlatData objects, with dynamic SQL schema construction.

classes.name: IndividualMandatorySavingsCollectionsheetExtractor

methods.name: buildJLGCollectionSheet

methods.name: generateIndividualCollectionSheet
